children: Solana recorded $2.64 billion in decentralized exchange trading volume over the past 24 hours, ranking first among all chains, according to DefiLlama data. According to ChainCatcher, Robinhood Chain ranked second with $1.57 billion in DEX volume during the same period, while BSC ranked third with $1.15 billion.

title: Solana Leads All Chains With $2.64 Billion In 24-Hour DEX Volume
